label: local-substitute
scope: Nested trace-redaction check (docs/TESTING_PLAN.md section 10, canaries in nested tools, model calls, exceptions). A real langsmith.Client with a fake HTTP session captures the exact request bodies; synthetic secret and phone canaries are planted in a traceable tool, a compiled subgraph, deep payloads, a node exception, the job payload and metadata keys. No network, no LangSmith cloud.
finding: The exception probe failed first: langsmith 0.14.14 masks a run's error string only through Client(anonymizer=...), not hide_inputs/hide_outputs/hide_metadata, so the canary secret and phone reached the exporter inside the error repr and traceback. Fixed by anonymizer=mask in observability.masked_client.
limits: The live LangSmith canary of 2026-11-03 predates the fix and did not exercise a failing node; it is not re-run (paid call, needs approval).
Logs, browser assets and attachments (TESTING_PLAN section 10) are covered by other checks or not at all; this file covers the exporter payload only.
Masking is pattern-based; a phone number spelled in words is not caught.
